title: Revision gives judgement clear foundations

captions.physics: Rebuilding a shared judgement’s inadequate basis

meaning: Rebuilding inadequate foundations can clarify substantial connections and bring proportion to a judgement genuinely related to the material before you.
text: Proportion can become understandable after a familiar judgement is revised. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly rebuilding its inadequate basis. The Sun in energy supports seeking clarity in substantial connections. Justice in emotions feels a refined judgement’s precision. Releasing a simple answer may feel difficult. Wanting concrete grounds understood reveals which part of experience it actually explains and where its boundary lies for both people.

For example, you thought a memorable mistake made an entire talk unsuccessful. Examining ideas heard, you stop making one episode sufficient foundations for judgement. **Revision can restore an understandable and proportionate subject to judgement.** Seeking clarity distinguishes one phrase’s accuracy from an explained connection’s value. Both aspects gain a place. A more precise impression can feel calming. Your view preserves the error while other parts retain significance. Each person can name what was understandable and which question stayed open without making one misstep represent everything heard together.

The risk is excluding the mistake as unimportant because revision brings relief. Wanting clarity preserves its actual scale. One episode does not cancel everything but remains part of the material. Your view can hold both connections while fair judgement rests on observations without defending an entire talk or rejecting it again through one inaccuracy already noticed.
